# ============================================================================= # Yaro - settings of the signed-in user, power plan, interrupts (part 2 of 2) # Runs at the first sign-in after Windows Setup, or via Yaro-Apply.cmd. # Log: C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\Yaro\FirstLogon.log # ============================================================================= $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue' function R([string]$Key, [string]$Name, [string]$Data, [string]$Type = 'REG_DWORD') { & reg.exe add $Key /v $Name /t $Type /d $Data /f *> $null if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { " FAIL $Key\$Name" } } $LogDir = 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\Yaro' New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $LogDir -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null Start-Transcript -Path (Join-Path $LogDir 'FirstLogon.log') -Append -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null "Yaro FirstLogon.ps1 started $(Get-Date) as $env:USERNAME"
"== Current user settings" R "HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop" 'MenuShowDelay' '0' 'REG_SZ' R "HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop" 'AutoEndTasks' '0' 'REG_SZ' R 'DirectXUserGlobalSettings' 'SwapEffectUpgradeEnable=1;VRROptimizeEnable=1;' 'REG_SZ' R "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize" 'AppsUseLightTheme' '0' 'REG_DWORD' R 'FolderType' 'NotSpecified' 'REG_SZ'
"== Power plan: Ultimate Performance, minimum CPU state 5%" & powercfg.exe -duplicatescheme e9a42b02-d5df-448d-aa00-03f14749eb61 e9a42b02-d5df-448d-aa00-03f14749eb62 *> $null & powercfg.exe /setacvalueindex e9a42b02-d5df-448d-aa00-03f14749eb62 SUB_PROCESSOR PROCTHROTTLEMIN 5 *> $null & powercfg.exe /setdcvalueindex e9a42b02-d5df-448d-aa00-03f14749eb62 SUB_PROCESSOR PROCTHROTTLEMIN 5 *> $null & powercfg.exe -setactive e9a42b02-d5df-448d-aa00-03f14749eb62 *> $null
"== Memory compression" Enable-MMAgent -MemoryCompression -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
"== MSI mode for GPU, NVMe and network adapters" Get-PnpDevice -PresentOnly -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Class -in 'Display', 'SCSIAdapter', 'Net' -and $_.InstanceId -like 'PCI\*' } | ForEach-Object { $k = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum\' + $_.InstanceId + '\Device Parameters\Interrupt Management\MessageSignaledInterruptProperties' if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $k) { Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $k -Name MSISupported -Value 1 -Type DWord; " MSI on: $($_.FriendlyName)" } }
"== Leftover apps of the current user" foreach ($a in 'Microsoft.Windows.DevHome', 'MicrosoftWindows.CrossDevice', 'Microsoft.Edge.GameAssist', 'AppUp.IntelGraphicsControlPanel', 'Microsoft.Copilot', 'Microsoft.BingSearch', 'MicrosoftWindows.Client.WebExperience', 'Microsoft.OutlookForWindows') { Get-AppxPackage -Name $a -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-AppxPackage -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
"Yaro FirstLogon.ps1 finished $(Get-Date)" Stop-Transcript -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null
